guards: a handler that reads a route parameter under a name its route, registered in another file outside the diff, does not declare is reported

bugs.truth: src/routes/users.js registers getUser for /:id under the /users mount, so Express fills req.params.id; req.params.userId is always undefined and every GET /users/:id now answers 404. Read req.params.id, or rename the route parameter to :userId.
